DataClass.description: What a task's prompts may contain: ``viewer`` data, or only ``operational`` data.
DataClass.title: DataClass

ModeEffort.description: Effort per mode of the scheduler agent.
ModeEffort.title: ModeEffort

ModelRoute.description: How a task reaches its model.
ModelRoute.title: ModelRoute

Thinking.description: Extended thinking: ``adaptive`` omits the field (the model's default); ``disabled`` turns it off.
Thinking.title: Thinking

description: SSM parameter /<prefix>/models/tasks/<task> (String, JSON), one per LLM task; scheduler.plan is the scheduling agent's. The model must be one of the deployment's allowed models, and profile_arn the task's application inference profile; readers refuse an entry that is invalid, names any other model or names another profile.

model.description: Bedrock model id or inference profile; one of ``agent.allowed_models``, with ``{geo}`` as there.
model.title: Model

route.description: ``bedrock``: the Converse API with the task's own role and application inference profile.

effort.description: Reasoning effort: one level, or one per mode (``chat``, ``plan``) for the scheduler agent.
effort.title: Effort

thinking.description: Extended thinking; fixed per task, because changing it per call rewrites the prompt cache.

max_tokens.description: Output token budget per model call.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

data_class.description:
``viewer`` if the task's prompts carry viewer data, which keeps the model on a geographic inference profile
(never ``global.``); swapping such a task's model needs human approval.

daily_cap_usd.description:
Daily model spend at which the task's token counter refuses further calls (about ten times expected use);
``null`` sets no cap.
daily_cap_usd.title: Daily Cap Usd

eval.description: Key of the passing evaluation record that qualifies ``model`` for this task.
eval.title: Eval

profile_arn.description:
The task's application inference profile, created by the deployment: the only model target its callers may
invoke.
profile_arn.title: Profile Arn
